area: Abbey Mills marsh east of Manor Road: Northern Outfall Sewer crest (top edge), LT&SR embankment crossing Manor Road on an underbridge, branch railway incline, open marsh with fence line (Plaistow marsh side)
method: QA independent second read. Sweep crops r0c0-r2c2 all displayed and anchored at opening (r0c0 MANOR ROAD lettering; r0c1 B.M.12·45 M.P.; r0c2 N O R sewer lettering; r1c0 F.W./F.B. and B.M.5·46; r1c1 B.M.12·45 and 17·3; r1c2 11·9/13·2 on bank; r2c0 Sluice label; r2c1 B.M.4·77 and fence line; r2c2 B.M.4·25). Region views (4x/3x) c1_reg1 (31·7/3·4), c1_reg2 (LT&SR bridge over Manor Road), c1_reg3 (sewer aqueduct), c1_reg4 (Manor Road 8·4/15·1), c1_nb (neighbour mosaic 131072_87143 image only, for context). Contact sheets c1_A (6x), c1_B (12x), c1_C3 (8x smooth+nearest, 5/6 test), c1_D (6x), c1_E (10x), c1_F3 (8x 5/6 comparison), c1_G (6x marsh fence line), c1_H and c1_I (12x B.M. decimals). Every crop and sheet displayed when opened. Dot centroids by numeric helper; positions checked on a marker sheet.
legibility: clear print; sheet joins at vertical px ~350 (full height, tint step) and horizontal py ~570 (full width, tint step, darker SW quadrant)
